title: Nye kontraktar for lagring av matkorn
locators: Heading ‘Nye kontraktar for lagring av matkorn’, paragraph beginning ‘Ved utgangen av 2024’
finding: Confirms 15,000 tonnes at end-2024 and distinguishes the 82,500-tonne target and future contracts.
verificationScope: Historical stock and policy/contract status; not current 2026 stock or deliverability

title: Landbruksdirektoratets årsrapport 2025
locators: Printed page 66; section on beredskapslagring av matkorn
finding: Reports 30,000 tonnes of mathvete purchased and stored at end-2025; also reports 30,000 tonnes and 22,500 tonnes in future-start contracts.
verificationScope: Official annual report statement of reported stock and contracts; not an independent physical inspection

title: Forbruk av korn til mat i Norge
locators: Heading ‘Forbruk av korn til mat i Norge’, opening statistics paragraph, paragraph beginning ‘I 2024 brukte møllene’, and paragraph beginning ‘Andelen norsk matkorn i melet’; updated 2025-06-05
finding: Reports 320,000 tonnes used by food mills in 2024 and separately states 37% Norwegian production and 40% Norwegian share in flour; the page does not establish that these are comparable, independently defined indicators.
verificationScope: Intermediary annual throughput page and unresolved source-defined shares; not nominal mill capacity or stock

title: Omverdenen til norsk landbruk og matindustri – rapport for 2025
finding: Reports 195,000 tonnes of mathvete imported by food flour mills in 2025 and gives origin shares.
verificationScope: Official annual import statistic; not stock, reserve volume, or milling capacity

title: Beredskapslagring av matkorn – forslag til utforming
finding: Historical survey estimated 63,400 tonnes free capacity in peak years, adjusted to 42,000 tonnes after exclusions and potentially 27,000 tonnes after 3-4 years; Buvika was leased to feed industry and assumptions were uncertain.
verificationScope: 2022/2023 self-reported capacity survey and scenario assumptions; not current capacity, stock, or throughput

title: Innspill til jordbruksforhandlingene 2025
locators: PDF page 5, paragraphs under ‘Behov for flere tiltak – utfordringer med manglende lagerkapasitet’
finding: Industry input estimates permanent storage up to 150,000-200,000 tonnes may be needed and says larger overstorage is already challenging.
verificationScope: Stakeholder estimate/scenario with an interest position; not an audited capacity measurement

title: Innst. 392 S (2025–2026), innledning
locators: Innst. 392 S headings ‘Forslag fra mindretall’ (proposal 5) and ‘Komiteens tilråding’; case page headings ‘Vedtak i korthet’ and ‘Vedtak og henstillinger’
finding: Six months of matkorn storage by 2030 was a minority proposal, not part of the two-point committee recommendation adopted in the 05.06.2026 vote; the adopted items concern critical production inputs and grocery-chain/local-government/defence agreements.
verificationScope: Parliamentary proposal, recommendation, and vote status; no implementation, funding, or contract evidence

title: Representantforslag om styrking av Norges matberedskap – saksside
locators: Headings ‘Vedtak i korthet’, ‘Vedtak og henstillinger’, and ‘Votering i Stortinget’; vote 05.06.2026
finding: Case page says the matter was completed and adopted in accordance with the recommendation; the short decision concerns critical inputs and agreements for food storage, not the six-month minority proposal.
verificationScope: Plenary case status and adopted decision summary; not implementation evidence

title: Votering 5. juni 2026
locators: Votering i sak nr. 7, proposal 5, vote at 14.10.20
finding: Six-month matkorn storage by 2030 proposal rejected, 81 to 20.
verificationScope: Read voting record independently; not implementation evidence
